name: Uncanny Valley: Machine
source:
Uncanny Valley: Machine is a story about a world that will be alien to you and at the same time familiar. This novel will tell you a story about survival, adaptation and overcoming the fears of the main character, about how two people find a way out of a monstrous situation.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2796140/]Steam[/url]]
